summary: Alithya Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board launched a strategic review to maximize shareholder value, citing that the public market valuation may not reflect intrinsic value. Alternatives include merger, privatization, sale, recapitalization, or strategic investments. No terms, advisors, or timetable disclosed; company continues executing its business plan. The Board will work with external financial and legal advisors. The process has no set timeline, and no transaction is assured. Watch for potential sale or privatization offers; risk-arb angle is speculative until specifics emerge.
